nameHint: The scenario name on the country-select screen, the first thing players read. Leave it empty and a new bookmark shows its raw id token there instead of a title; a bookmark that reuses a vanilla id keeps the vanilla name.
confirmDelete: Delete this bookmark? (common/bookmarks/'<'id>.txt + both yml localisations will be removed from export)
title: Bookmark Workbench — the country-selection entry (name, card art, story hook, selectable countries)
intro: Vanilla equivalent: <mono>common/bookmarks/the_gathering_storm.txt</mono> (1936) / <mono>blitzkrieg.txt</mono> (1939). Each per-country block carries the hover blurb plus the selection-screen preview (ideology, national spirits, focuses) — HOI4 reads those from the bookmark itself, not from the country history file.
emptyListHint: The scenario entry players pick on the country-select screen — defined here.
selectHint: Select a bookmark on the left to edit · or click "+ New bookmark".
idLabel: Bookmark ID (file id · loc key prefix · snake_case lowercase)
incrementalUpdate: Incremental update (only the fields below change · others kept)
descEnLabel: Bookmark description EN (story hook · long text)
descZhLabel: Bookmark description ZH (story hook · long text)
pictureHint: Vanilla examples: <mono>GFX_select_date_1936</mono> / <mono>GFX_select_date_1939</mono>. Upload custom card art below and the program crops it to 180×104, converts it to DDS, registers the sprite, and fills this field. (Advanced: you can still manage your own <mono>GFX_…</mono> + <mono>interface/*.gfx</mono>.)
backdropUploadLabel: Custom scenario card (180×104 · upload → DDS + sprite registration)
backdropUploadHint: Upload the artwork shown inside this scenario's selection card. Choose the crop you want to keep; export writes the vanilla 180×104 card size. Leave empty to keep the vanilla card art.
backdropUploadCreateFirst: Create this scenario first. Once it is created, you can upload its card art here.
defaultCountryLabel: Default country TAG (cursor position when the bookmark opens)
defaultBookmarkLabel: Default bookmark (<mono>default = yes</mono> · auto-selected when HOI4 opens)
defaultWarning: {count} other bookmark(s) in this project are already marked "default"{list}. With multiple defaults, the vanilla engine uses the last one loaded. That's allowed on purpose — some multi-bookmark setups need two defaults.
singleBookmarkHint: Only one bookmark in this project — HOI4 will skip the bookmark-selection screen and start this scenario directly.
selectableEmpty: Click "+ Add country" to add selectable countries · each entry sets the hover blurb (history) plus the selection-screen preview: ideology, national spirits and focuses. HOI4 reads those three from the bookmark entry itself — it does not fall back to history/countries/{tag}.
hoverZhPlaceholder: e.g. 共和国孤身面对欧洲
countryAvailableHint: HOI4 trigger script (the contents go inside the braces). Most common idiom is DLC gating, e.g. has_dlc = "La Resistance". Leave empty for an always-available country. Real mods (and vanilla) use this heavily for the dual-block-per-TAG pattern.
filtersHint: Choose the filter groups HOI4 1.19 supports. Country-specific button names come from each country's labels through the label choice.
legacyFiltersPreserved: These tokens came from existing content. They will be preserved exactly when you save, but HOI4 1.19 may not recognize them. Review them before export.
legacyFiltersLabelHint: {tokens} match country label values. If you wanted buttons with those names, enable label instead; the names come from each country's Filter labels field.
countryLabelsNeedFilter: Countries below have filter labels, but the label filter is off. Enable label so those buttons appear on the country-selection screen.
advancedFields: Advanced fields (central-panel preview on the selection screen
ideologyMissingImpact: The country-selection screen uses this value for the leader, ideology icon, country name, and flag. This is a quality warning, not a claimed game crash.
startNS: Starting NS (separate idea_id by comma or newline · 1-3 recommended)
focusPreviewLabel: Selection-screen focus preview (vanilla has exactly 3 · max {max} · same separators as above)
limitWarning: Reached the limit of {max} · extras will be truncated
overrideLeaderPortraitLabel: Leader portrait override (override_leader_portrait · GFX sprite name)
overrideLeaderPortraitHint: A GFX sprite name defined in interface/*.gfx (e.g. JAP_emperor_hirohito), shown as the leader portrait on the selection screen. References an existing sprite — not a file upload. Leave empty for the country's default leader portrait.
versionHint: Vanilla tags each country entry with the game version it belongs to, e.g. version = base_game. Pair it with an available trigger when the same country has several entries. Leave empty to omit the line.
newContentRetiredNotice: This entry still carries new_content, which the game rejects inside a country block (Unexpected token) — it is no longer written to the export. In vanilla, new_content is only a filter name at bookmark level; the per-country field is version, above.
emptyHeroTitle: Bookmarks are the front door to your mod
previewUnavailable: Bookmarks have no in-game preview yet — the scenario card art and selectable-country list are visible in the editor.
replacePathAutoTitle: A custom opening takes over the vanilla scenario list
replacePathAutoDesc: Because the earliest valid saved scenario is not the vanilla 1936 opening, export takes over the vanilla scenario directory and uses this project's scenario list.
replacePathSingleWarning: With only one scenario, HOI4 skips the scenario-selection screen. After reaching country selection, players cannot return to the main menu.
replacePathSingleAction: Add a second scenario if you want players to see the scenario-selection screen.
replacePathSecondDraft: The second scenario is not saved yet. Once saved, players will see scenario selection and can return from country selection.
replacePathSecondReady: The second scenario is saved. Players now see scenario selection first and can return to the main menu.
